record_title: Strict concavity and logarithmic endpoint asymptotics of the harmonic distortion constant
provenance: A quantitative strengthening of the sharp center pointwise-distortion constant determined in arXiv:2609.19609, using its exact one-parameter extremal and elliptic-integral formulas.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The result concerns the center constant and extremal family from arXiv:2609.19609; it does not treat off-center prescribed values, general targets, or global quasiconformal distortion. The constant's source theorem is very recent, so unindexed contemporaneous observations remain a residual risk. No independent validation or formal proof-assistant verification is asserted.
